name: Remix Ink2Web Express
description:
Core Features
- WCAG 2.2 AA compliant: Converts handwritten or printed notes into structurally valid, semantically rich web documents.
- Smart figure handling: Automatically crops figures and generates AI-powered descriptions and alt text. These can all be edited before downloading the HTML.
- Precision math rendering: Transforms complex equations into screen-reader-friendly LaTeX.
- Visual refinement: Includes basic touch-up tools for figures and graphs.
- Ad digitandum paratus!
